summary: Short kerb at about 19% grade, too steep to park on.
reasons: Apartments 18 m away across the kerb
Angle bays are shared with parked cars

best_section.where: North kerb at the bend, under the large tree by the angle bays

drivers.seclusion: The Peak apartments 18 m away; other flats 23-24 m. Wooded and enclosed, with homes on all sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with angle and parallel bays used by parked cars; room is limited on a 23 m stretch.
drivers.convention: Cars park here under P Angle signs, but a No Parking Any Time sign is on the kerb.

flags: No Parking Any Time sign on this kerb
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the kerb, mostly from the north and east.
